notes.chembl_ligands: Unique ChEMBL ligand names and bioactivity rows as integrated by GPCRdb.
notes.drugs: GPCRdb drugs combine DrugBank, ChEMBL and Guide to Pharmacology. DrugBank has no separate open target download.
notes.similarity: Percent identity, and percent of columns with BLOSUM62 > 0, on the GPCRdb alignment. Columns where both sequences are gapped are ignored.
notes.expression: Protein values are ProteomicsDB normalized intensities for tissues and fluids. mRNA is Human Protein Atlas RNA-seq (TPM) hosted by ProteomicsDB.
